description: This file implements a logging backend for Zephyr RTOS using SEGGER RTT for output. It manages buffering, message formatting, and transmission of logs over RTT, including handling dropped messages and panic mode.

methods.name: log_backend_rtt_cfg
methods.description: Configures the RTT buffer for logging.

methods.name: panic
methods.description: Handles panic mode for the backend, switching to panic state.

methods.name: process
methods.description: Processes a log message and outputs it via RTT.

methods.name: data_out_block_mode
methods.description: Outputs data in block mode with retries.

methods.name: data_out_drop_mode
methods.description: Outputs data in drop mode, handling dropped messages.

methods.name: char_out_drop_mode
methods.description: Handles character output in drop mode, buffering until newline.

methods.name: line_out_drop_mode
methods.description: Outputs a line in drop mode, including dropped message count.

methods.name: on_failed_write
methods.description: Handles failed write attempts, with retries.

methods.name: on_write
methods.description: Handles successful write, managing host presence and panic mode.

methods.name: is_sync_mode
methods.description: Checks if the backend is in synchronous mode.

methods.name: is_panic_mode
methods.description: Checks if the backend is in panic mode.
